response.text: I'll start by verifying the key claims in the notes, beginning with journal balance, invoice duplicates, and period/posting checks.

arguments.sql: SELECT j."JRNL_NO", SUM(j."DR_AMT") AS dr, SUM(j."CR_AMT") AS cr, SUM(j."DR_AMT")-SUM(j."CR_AMT") AS diff FROM public."GLJRNL" j GROUP BY j."JRNL_NO" HAVING ABS(SUM(j."DR_AMT")-SUM(j."CR_AMT"))>0.001

SELECT UPPER(LTRIM(TRIM(REGEXP_REPLACE(i."INV_NO",'[^A-Za-z0-9]','','g')),'0')) AS k, TRIM(i."VEND_CD") AS v, COUNT(*) AS n, ARRAY_AGG(i."INV_ID") AS ids FROM public."APINVH" i GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING COUNT(*)>1

SELECT h."JRNL_NO", h."PRD_ID", p."STAT_CD", p."CLOSE_DT", h."POST_DT" FROM public."GLJRNH" h JOIN public."GLPERD" p ON p."PRD_ID"=h."PRD_ID" WHERE p."STAT_CD"='C' AND h."POST_DT" BETWEEN p."STRT_DT" AND p."END_DT" AND h."POST_DT" > p."CLOSE_DT" LIMIT 50

SELECT a."ACCT_CD", TRIM(a."ACCT_CD") AS t, COUNT(*) FROM public."GLJRNL" l LEFT JOIN public."GLCOA" a ON TRIM(a."ACCT_CD")=TRIM(l."ACCT_CD") WHERE a."ACCT_CD" IS NULL OR a."ACTV_FLG"<>'Y' GROUP BY 1,2

SELECT i."INV_ID", i."INV_AMT", SUM(p."PAY_AMT") AS paid, i."STAT_CD" FROM public."APINVH" i LEFT JOIN public."APPAYM" p ON p."INV_ID"=i."INV_ID" GROUP BY i."INV_ID", i."INV_AMT", i."STAT_CD" HAVING ROUND(SUM(COALESCE(p."PAY_AMT",0))::numeric,2)<>ROUND(i."INV_AMT"::numeric,2) AND i."STAT_CD"='P'

SELECT i."INV_ID", i."VEND_CD", i."INV_AMT", j."JRNL_NO", SUM(l."DR_AMT") AS dr, SUM(l."CR_AMT") AS cr FROM public."APINVH" i JOIN public."GLJRNH" j ON j."JRNL_NO"=i."JRNL_NO" JOIN public."GLJRNL" l ON l."JRNL_NO"=j."JRNL_NO" GROUP BY i."INV_ID", i."VEND_CD", i."INV_AMT", j."JRNL_NO" HAVING ROUND(SUM(l."CR_AMT")::numeric,2)<>ROUND(i."INV_AMT"::numeric,2) LIMIT 50
